cases.title: Wrong checkout / dirty worktree
cases.procedure: Try the helper against a different origin, a dirty tree, and a detached HEAD.
cases.expected: Apply fails without modifying existing files or changing branches.

cases.title: Preview and collision safety
cases.procedure: Preview then apply on a clean feature branch; repeat. Introduce an existing different AGENTS.md in a separate fixture.
cases.expected: Preview is read-only; repeat is idempotent; differing files are reported, not overwritten.

cases.title: Initial checkpoint
cases.procedure: Compare runtime files before/after governance import; commit and push only intended handoff files. Run live sync-check.
cases.expected: Runtime content is unchanged; clean worktree, matching local/live-remote branch HEAD, and a real PR reference or explicit API blocker are recorded.

cases.title: Compatibility entry points
cases.procedure: Invoke the original -inputPath call and the .bat entry point with controlled input in both available Windows shells.
cases.expected: Existing modes and entry points remain; unavailable shell runs are marked not-run, not passed.

cases.title: No import side effects
cases.procedure: Load test helpers in a fresh process with FFmpeg/process-start mocked.
cases.expected: No menu, process, writes, or exit on import; tests can run unattended.

cases.title: Useful checks
cases.procedure: Run the new Quick runner, deliberately break a tested helper in an isolated worktree, then restore it.
cases.expected: The runner fails for the deliberate defect and passes after restoration; no broad analyzer suppressions hide it.

cases.title: Legacy filter identity
cases.procedure: Compare built filter strings for Raw and Zoom with BASELINE.json.
cases.expected: Parameter values and order match exactly; output-container changes are recorded separately.

cases.title: Reproducible synthetic baseline
cases.procedure: Run characterization twice using the same local build and inputs.
cases.expected: Versions, commands, fixture hashes and output format are recorded; variation is investigated rather than masked.

cases.title: Private corpus handling
cases.procedure: Check ignore rules and staged files before adding the listening-review record.
cases.expected: No private recordings or identifying local paths are staged; missing listening material is explicitly pending.

cases.title: Baseline completeness
cases.procedure: Check source identities, filters, runnable test commands and environment inventory.
cases.expected: Each exists with actual evidence; unexecuted Windows/listening checks remain distinguishable.

cases.title: Plan consistency
cases.procedure: Run the plan validator after changing task status.
cases.expected: No unknown dependency, duplicate ID, missing acceptance link, or done task without evidence.

cases.title: Thread restart
cases.procedure: Start from a fresh Codex thread reading NEXT_MODEL_START_HERE.md and git.
cases.expected: The next task and unverified checks are clear without reconstructing prior chat or repeating the entire audit.

cases.title: Literal path matrix
cases.procedure: Use files with spaces, square brackets, apostrophes, ä/ö/Å, ampersands, percent signs, exclamation marks and parentheses.
cases.expected: Each resolves to one intended file; no wildcard expansion or unexpected command execution.

cases.title: Validation order
cases.procedure: Try no input, directory, nonexistent input, URL, unwritable destination and zero-byte corrupt media.
cases.expected: Clear preflight diagnostics; no mode prompt for invalid paths and no misleading successful export.

cases.title: Menu correctness
cases.procedure: Enter empty, invalid, valid and cancel choices. Run missing mode with noninteractive semantics.
cases.expected: Invalid input cannot silently select Zoom; cancellation/noninteractive failure is explicit.

cases.title: Argument fidelity
cases.procedure: Use a benign argv-echo test executable or equivalent recorder with the filename matrix through both the direct script and actual launcher.
cases.expected: The child receives exact arguments; command-like filenames cannot become commands; any CMD limitation gets a safe fallback and explicit notice.

cases.title: Error propagation
cases.procedure: Simulate startup failure, FFmpeg nonzero exit, failed reporting, and successful execution.
cases.expected: Script and launcher return documented codes and retain useful diagnostic details without claiming success.

cases.title: Output and stream handling
cases.procedure: Have a test child write large stdout/stderr streams, then exit; repeat with a known synthetic FFmpeg job.
cases.expected: No deadlock or truncation of essential errors; all handles are closed and completion is accurately observed.

cases.title: Dependency resolution
cases.procedure: Test explicit, sibling and PATH locations; missing, incompatible and selected-mode-filter-deficient builds.
cases.expected: Precedence is deterministic, failures are actionable, and no download happens without consent.

cases.title: Stream choice
cases.procedure: Use a container with two distinguishable tracks and a video-only container.
cases.expected: Selected absolute stream index maps to the expected audio; no-audio fails before cleaning; unattended ambiguity fails.

cases.title: Probe safety
cases.procedure: Test malformed JSON, timeout, nonzero probe exit and local playlist referencing an external URL.
cases.expected: No false metadata or unbounded hang; unsupported network references are rejected/blocked and documented.

cases.title: Collision and concurrency
cases.procedure: Run same input twice rapidly and two inputs with the same stem; run concurrent jobs targeting one destination.
cases.expected: Every completed output is unique and prior results/source hashes remain unchanged.

cases.title: Failure before publication
cases.procedure: Inject encoder failure, disk-full simulation, invalid output, and a crash before rename.
cases.expected: No normal-looking final export is published; originals/prior exports remain untouched; partial files are identifiable.

cases.title: Rename race / validation
cases.procedure: Create the intended final filename after name selection; simulate exit 0 with an empty or truncated output.
cases.expected: No existing file is replaced; validation blocks invalid output and reports the true failure.

cases.title: Explicit output matrix
cases.procedure: Process 44.1/48 kHz mono and stereo fixtures in both modes and 16/24-bit choices; inspect with ffprobe.
cases.expected: Selected sample rate/codec/channels are correct; no accidental 192 kHz default export.

cases.title: Timing and channels
cases.procedure: Use stereo channels with different signals and known impulses; compare start/end and duration before/after.
cases.expected: No unintended downmix, channel swap, silence removal, leading offset or unexplained timing drift.

cases.title: Large-file and space policy
cases.procedure: Unit-test estimates around the WAV size boundary and inject low-space conditions; exercise an RF64 header with a small supported fixture.
cases.expected: Policy is deterministic and documented; full >4 GB stress is run only when risk warrants it, or clearly not claimed as tested.

cases.title: Report fidelity
cases.procedure: Run success, encoder failure and validation failure; compare console, JSON, human log and process exit.
cases.expected: Statuses agree; recording duration differs from wall time; unsupported/nonfinite measurements become null plus reason.

cases.title: Privacy export
cases.procedure: Generate a report containing user-directory names, filenames, container title and potential sensitive diagnostic text.
cases.expected: Redacted output omits sensitive values and warns about review; raw report remains local only.

cases.title: Concurrent and failed logging
cases.procedure: Run concurrent exports and inject a log destination permission failure.
cases.expected: Reports do not overwrite/interleave incorrectly; audio is not deleted solely because reporting failed; outcome is unambiguous.

cases.title: Cumulative regression
cases.procedure: Run the documented M0+M1 suite on the active Windows machine in available supported shells.
cases.expected: All mandatory local checks pass, or the milestone remains blocked with exact failures.

cases.title: Non-destructive review
cases.procedure: Inspect all file-writing, rename and cleanup paths alongside fault-injection results.
cases.expected: No source/prior export overwrite, broad cleanup, silent output ambiguity or false-success path remains known.

cases.title: Remote checkpoint
cases.procedure: Run live sync-check after pushing the implementation/evidence commit and inspect PR state.
cases.expected: Clean worktree and identical local/live remote HEAD; CI state is accurately separated from local results.

cases.title: Claims audit
cases.procedure: Search all shipped docs/help/website drafts for old claims and compare parameter descriptions to official docs.
cases.expected: Units and limitations are accurate; -12 LUFS is a chosen preset, not a universal broadcast standard.

cases.title: Preset compatibility
cases.procedure: Compare Original Raw/Zoom filter strings and synthetic output with the baseline on the same build/output settings.
cases.expected: Filter values/order remain; any differences are explained by explicit encoder behavior rather than silent retuning.

cases.title: Preset version report
cases.procedure: Select Original from existing interactive paths and a test invocation.
cases.expected: The effective preset ID/version appears in the report and is not confused with the application version.

cases.title: Pass consistency
cases.procedure: Capture both commands for Raw/Zoom, selected stream, mono/stereo and numeric locale variations.
cases.expected: Prechains, stream, channel policy and parameters match; second pass uses valid pass-1 measurements and invariant decimals.

cases.title: Output measurements
cases.procedure: Run eligible full-length fixtures at -12 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP and verify final-file loudness/peak.
cases.expected: Achievable cases meet declared tolerances; constraints/fallbacks are reported and out-of-tolerance results are not called target-compliant.

cases.title: Undefined and fallback cases
cases.procedure: Use silence, <1-second audio, restricted peak headroom, high LRA and malformed measurement output.
cases.expected: No unchecked nonfinite values, infinite retries, division errors, or false exact-target claims; fallback is logged.

cases.title: Parameter validation
cases.procedure: Test valid bounds, invalid values, unknown settings and filter-like injected strings.
cases.expected: Only typed allowlisted settings construct the graph; no arbitrary filter/command injection through configuration.

cases.title: Defaults unchanged
cases.procedure: Run the existing no-extra-options Raw and Zoom paths after adding presets.
cases.expected: Original filters remain the default; Zoom does not accidentally enable cleaning stages.

cases.title: Listening candidate record
cases.procedure: Compare original/gentle on the approved local corpus or record why unavailable.
cases.expected: Reviewer evaluates words, consonants, breaths, voice character and artifacts; synthetic checks are not presented as listening approval.

cases.title: Range and alignment
cases.procedure: Preview from start, middle and near end of a known timed fixture plus a very short recording.
cases.expected: Valid matched intervals only; no unexplained offset, overwrite or out-of-range processing.

cases.title: Comparison gain
cases.procedure: Measure the original/processed comparison pair with the documented matching method.
cases.expected: Level matching is separate from the mastering preset and does not introduce clipping; unmeasurable cases are clearly labeled.

cases.title: No hidden processing
cases.procedure: Create/cancel a preview and inspect files, current settings and process state.
cases.expected: No full recording starts implicitly, source is unchanged and only run-owned preview files are cleaned up.

cases.title: Objective audio gate
cases.procedure: Run all applicable M2 numeric and structural checks.
cases.expected: Mandatory implemented-mode checks pass; ineligible/undefined metrics are explicitly classified.

cases.title: Human gate integrity
cases.procedure: Inspect listening template, corpus consent and approval records.
cases.expected: Real reviewer results are attributable; missing listening approval prevents default promotion, not a fabricated pass.

cases.title: Reproducible settings
cases.procedure: Recreate an output from the report using the same build/input/settings and push the checkpoint.
cases.expected: Preset/format choices are traceable and the exact accepted revision is recoverable from GitHub.

cases.title: Precedence matrix
cases.procedure: Set conflicting built-in, saved and CLI values then reset settings.
cases.expected: Documented precedence wins; legacy input invocation remains valid.

cases.title: Unattended behavior
cases.procedure: Run with all required values; omit a required mode/stream or supply invalid settings with redirected stdin.
cases.expected: No prompt/pause or hang; valid jobs run and invalid jobs fail with a useful exit code.

cases.title: Config durability
cases.procedure: Test malformed JSON, unknown schema, wrong types, interrupted save and German/Finnish decimal culture.
cases.expected: Safe diagnostics, previous valid config preserved and invariant FFmpeg serialization; no arbitrary code execution.

cases.title: Real drag/drop matrix
cases.procedure: Drop one and several files, including spaces, Unicode, brackets, %, !, &, apostrophes and parentheses, onto the actual launcher.
cases.expected: Each intended input appears once in the queue without truncation, corruption or command execution.

cases.title: Aggregate result
cases.procedure: Process a list containing valid and invalid items.
cases.expected: Per-item results persist; overall exit code reflects failure; single-file behavior remains compatible.

cases.title: Boundary handling
cases.procedure: Test many/long paths and double-click with no files.
cases.expected: No silently lost inputs; actionable safe fallback for launcher limits and clear no-input guidance.

cases.title: Folder selection
cases.procedure: Process a mixed folder including output files, nested folders and a junction/symlink loop fixture.
cases.expected: Recursion is off by default; no loop or generated-output reprocessing; unsupported files are explained/skipped.

cases.title: Queue stability
cases.procedure: Select duplicate paths and inputs with identical stems; place the destination inside the input folder.
cases.expected: Inputs are deduplicated, names remain collision-safe and newly generated output never enters the running queue.

cases.title: Failure continuation
cases.procedure: Fail a middle item and process remaining items; repeat with cancellation.
cases.expected: Failure does not discard other results; cancellation stops new jobs and aggregate status is truthful.

cases.title: Progress semantics
cases.procedure: Run fast/accurate/preview jobs, variable-speed data and unknown duration.
cases.expected: Progress is bounded, stage labels correct, and 100% is not shown before validation/publication.

cases.title: Owned-process cancellation
cases.procedure: Run two independent jobs, cancel one at analysis/render/verification in separate tests.
cases.expected: Only the cancelled run stops; no new queued job starts; originals/other exports remain intact.

cases.title: Abnormal child / console
cases.procedure: Force unexpected child exit, truncated progress lines and closed/redirected console.
cases.expected: No deadlock, misleading success or unbounded wait; final status remains in the report.

cases.title: Destination choices
cases.procedure: Run Music/default, custom, per-job and unavailable redirected Music-folder scenarios.
cases.expected: Predictable paths with safe fallback/error; no writes to unexpected current directories.

cases.title: No-GUI operation
cases.procedure: Run from a terminal/redirected session without desktop interaction.
cases.expected: Processing and diagnostics work with no file-picker or Explorer dependency.

cases.title: Explicit follow-up actions
cases.procedure: Complete success/failure runs and exercise optional open-folder/cancel-picker actions.
cases.expected: Only requested safe actions occur; failures do not falsely offer a completed output.

cases.title: Original workflow
cases.procedure: Drop a typical interview file, select 1/2 and inspect the result/report.
cases.expected: Same simple front-door experience remains; new settings do not overwhelm the default menu.

cases.title: Automation workflow
cases.procedure: Invoke unattended batch with explicit parameters and examine process codes/files/reports.
cases.expected: No prompt, missing file, misleading aggregate result or timing change.

cases.title: Reentry workflow
cases.procedure: Restart in a new thread or clean checkout with recorded settings intentionally absent.
cases.expected: Built-in defaults suffice; state and remaining tasks are recovered from Git, not hidden machine settings.

cases.title: Coverage traceability
cases.procedure: Map every implemented acceptance ID to a test command/report or a named manual review.
cases.expected: No implemented behavior relies solely on a roadmap checkbox; mandatory gaps remain visible.

cases.title: Mutation / fault checks
cases.procedure: Inject representative overwrite, bad exit and wrong-sample-rate defects in an isolated test tree.
cases.expected: Relevant tests detect them; test fixture cleanup cannot remove real user files.

cases.title: Efficient repeatability
cases.procedure: Run Quick and selected Targeted suites after a narrow change, then one Full gate.
cases.expected: Runners are reusable and evidence tied to revision; no repetitive all-project audit is required for every small edit.

cases.title: CI/local parity
cases.procedure: Compare workflow commands and versions to local runners; run a PR check.
cases.expected: Same checks are invoked, versions recorded, real green/failure status linked to the tested SHA.

cases.title: Workflow permissions
cases.procedure: Review permissions, triggers, pinned actions, downloads and secrets exposure.
cases.expected: Untrusted PR tests cannot publish releases/access private recordings/secrets; no broad write token by default.

cases.title: Truthful fallback
cases.procedure: Simulate unavailable CI or one unsupported local shell.
cases.expected: Local and CI results remain distinct; neither an API outage nor an unrun job becomes a passed gate.

cases.title: Package contents
cases.procedure: Build twice from the same inputs; inspect archive entries and metadata/checksums.
cases.expected: Version and content manifest agree; reproducibility claims match actual results; no private/development-only files.

cases.title: Fresh package use
cases.procedure: Extract into a clean user-writable folder with spaces/Unicode; supply approved local dependencies.
cases.expected: The documented .bat and PowerShell paths work without a repo, Python or test modules installed.

cases.title: Licensing and integrity
cases.procedure: Review included notices, dependency provenance and generated hashes.
cases.expected: MIT notice is preserved; bundled third-party build obligations are checked or bundling remains explicitly blocked.

cases.title: Examples execute
cases.procedure: Follow installation and commands from a clean release ZIP on the active machine.
cases.expected: Examples run without hidden setup; help contains valid parameter descriptions and actual defaults.

cases.title: Support and privacy
cases.procedure: Walk through missing dependency, corrupt media, permissions, output collision and redacted-report guidance.
cases.expected: User can diagnose without uploading private audio or changing machine-wide security settings.

cases.title: Claims consistency
cases.procedure: Compare README/Get-Help/preset labels/reports and website draft metadata.
cases.expected: Versions, LUFS/peak units, local-processing statement and limitations agree.

cases.title: Architecture boundary
cases.procedure: Inspect page code, browser requests and runtime script behavior.
cases.expected: Website only presents/distributes; tool never needs the website to process audio; no upload endpoint/telemetry is introduced.

cases.title: Metadata correctness
cases.procedure: Validate draft and published-like fixture metadata against packaging output.
cases.expected: No fabricated release link/hash; draft/unpublished assets cannot appear as a working stable download.

cases.title: Accessible presentation
cases.procedure: Test keyboard navigation, meaningful labels, readable layout and sample consent records.
cases.expected: Page is usable and honest; missing real assets are marked pending without fake screenshots/reviews.

cases.title: GitHub reconstruction
cases.procedure: Fetch the checkpoint and create a clean detached worktree/clone for the explicit SHA.
cases.expected: Project builds/tests using documented prerequisites; no hidden local edits or untracked runtime dependencies are required.

cases.title: Candidate integrity
cases.procedure: Compare candidate contents, hashes and version across packaging and website metadata.
cases.expected: All artifacts identify the same source revision/version; invalid checksum/version inputs fail validation.

cases.title: Privacy and rollback
cases.procedure: Review candidate files and documented rollback to a prior release/source tag.
cases.expected: No confidential content ships and rollback does not erase source recordings/settings without consent.

cases.title: Complete traceability
cases.procedure: Audit TRACEABILITY.md, TASKS.yaml, evidence and release checklist once.
cases.expected: All improvements are implemented/verified or explicitly deferred with owner approval; no placeholder is reported as complete.

cases.title: Safe acceptance
cases.procedure: Review mandatory safety tests and all pending subjective/platform checks.
cases.expected: Known data-loss/security/false-success regressions block acceptance; unreviewed sound changes stay opt-in/experimental.

cases.title: Delivery checkpoint
cases.procedure: Verify clean worktree, live remote SHA, PR/check status and candidate artifact manifest.
cases.expected: Owner receives a recoverable, approval-ready checkpoint, not a claim that unapproved release/deployment already occurred.

cases.title: Approval boundary
cases.procedure: Attempt to plan merge/tag/release/settings change/deployment without a matching approval record.
cases.expected: Action stays blocked; no side effect. Ordinary feature commits/pushes/draft PR updates remain permitted.

cases.title: Exact target check
cases.procedure: Compare approved SHA/artifact/target to the live candidate immediately before action.
cases.expected: Mismatch stops publication and returns an updated proposal; no force push or surprise main push.

cases.title: Post-action verification
cases.procedure: For each approved action, check actual remote state and downloaded asset hash/site metadata.
cases.expected: Recorded result matches what was published; outstanding approvals and rollback route are explicit.
